learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the basics of data structures and will be able to use basic methods of designing efficient algorithms.
They will be able to work with basic concepts of computational complexity.

syllabus_topics: Methods of designing efficient algorithms (greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, divide and conquer)
Representations of graphs and elementary graph algorithms
assessment_rules: To successfully complete the course, a student must obtain at least 50% of points on the final exam. The final grade is determined by: A (90%), B (80%), C (70%), D (60%), E (50%). The assessment scale is 50% from continuing evaluation and 50% from the final exam.
bibliography: Fundamentals of algorithmics / Gilles Brassard, Paul Bratley. Englewood Cliffs : Prentice-Hall
Data Structures and Algorithms in Python / Michael T. Goodrich, Roberto Tamassia, Michael H. Goldwasser. John Wiley & Sons, 2013.
Introduction to algorithms / Thomas H. Cormen ... [et al.]. Cambridge, Mass. : MIT Press, 2001
Programming pearls / Jon Bentley. Reading : Addison-Wesley, 1986
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
